rules: When generating a path, output the shortest valid path under the implied connectivity.
Do not repeat a room in the path unless necessary.

variants.flat: You are in a building. You start at the Entrance (R1), located at (0,0), which contains a Sofa and a Cabinet. Moving East from the Entrance (R1), you enter the Kitchen (R2) at (4,0), which contains a Microwave and a Cabinet. Moving East from the Kitchen (R2), you enter the Living Room (R3) at (8,0), which contains a Oven and a Oven. Moving West from the Living Room (R3), you enter the Bedroom (R4) at (0,4), which contains a Desk and a Desk. Moving East from the Bedroom (R4), you enter the Bathroom (R5) at (4,4), which contains a Microwave and a Microwave. Interestingly, the Bathroom features a connection back to the Entrance. At t1, a 'Master_Key' was in the Entrance (R1). At t2, it was picked up and moved to the Kitchen (R2). At t3, it was picked up and moved to the Living Room (R3).
